idea-plugin.name: JTools
idea-plugin.description:
JTools is a powerful and lightweight plugin management container designed specifically for JetBrains IDEs. It revolutionizes the plugin development experience by providing hot-plugging capabilities, allowing developers to install, update, and uninstall plugins without restarting the IDE.
📖 Documentation | 🐛 Report Issues | 📦 Releases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🤖 Coding Session: Project-scoped coding dialog rewritten around message events, with streaming replies, reasoning, tool timeline, append/queue, attachments, async context compaction, and incremental live updates.
  • 🧩 Coding Environment: Sessions bind a coding environment as the capability pack for system prompt, tools, plugin functions, skills, multimodal view_* tools, and compaction agent.
  • 📊 Context Metrics: Token usage, turn/step counts, tool calls, and context window occupancy appear under the composer, with a dedicated context compaction dialog that runs in the background.
  • 🧭 Provider Manager: Multi-provider configuration (OpenAI/Anthropic) with base URL, headers, and proxy.
  • 🎛️ Provider Selector: Provider selector with model lists fetched from each provider.
  • 🧩 Provider Templates: OpenAI-compatible provider types and vendor templates with preset endpoints and parameter hints for easier third-party model integration.
  • 🌍 Broad Provider Coverage: Built-in templates for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Ollama, and Anthropic-style integrations.
  • 🧰 Function Calling: Aggregated plugin and system tools with unique identifiers to avoid name conflicts.
  • 🧩 Structured MCP CLI Tool: A single cli tool covers MCP server configuration, connection tests, resource reads, and tool calls, with a doc command returning the full MCP command reference.
  • 🔌 MCP Client: Manage and call external MCP servers over stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP on the official MCP Java SDK, with persisted server configs and connection testing.
  • 📦 Plugin Ops: Local/URL/batch install and uninstall tool calls for faster workflows.
  • 🧪 Dev Testing: Developer panel can expose current plugin instance tool calls for debugging.
  • 📎 Attachment Workflow: Attach local files and images to chat, with model-aware capability checks, clipboard support, and optimized upload handling.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Inputs: Per-model capability switches for image, audio, video, and file attachments, with automatic text extraction for readable files.
  • 🧠 Skill Management: Import or edit local SKILL.md skills, attach them per session, and expose skill resources directly to the agent runtime.
  • 📚 Skill Resources: references/examples/scripts resources can be mounted into agent sessions and read through dedicated resource tools.
  • 🔗 Skill Runtime Integration: Skills share the same runtime Toolkit as built-in and plugin tools, keeping SkillBox tool groups aligned with the active agent session.
  • 🎚️ Model Tuning: Configure per-model streaming, multimodal capabilities, and advanced OpenAI/Anthropic parameters from a dedicated tuning panel.
  • 🧾 Parameter Guidance: Store provider-level default and recommended parameters to make model configuration more repeatable across sessions.
  • 💾 Session Persistence: Restore sessions, enabled skills, draft attachments, and active context across projects for long-running conversations.
  • 🧠 Runtime State: Session runtime can preserve memory, tool state, and planning context for more consistent multi-step workflows.
  • ⚙️ Agent Limits: Configurable max tool iterations and tool result size limits to prevent oversized context.
  • 📂 File Listing: jtools_list_files supports maxEntries with truncation metadata.
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: WebFetch works as a direct HTTP client with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw bodies, form params, timeout control, and Web tool proxy settings.
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Browser tools can open a temporary JCEF browser session, run visible or hidden after user choice, read pages, observe element refs, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and destroy the dynamic tool window when finished.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution
  • Connecting private or third-party model services through vendor templates without rebuilding the plugin workflow

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档 | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🤖 编码会话：按项目工作区重写的编码对话框，基于消息事件时间线，支持流式回复、推理、工具时间线、追加/排队、附件、异步上下文压缩和增量实时更新。
  • 🧩 编码环境：会话绑定编码环境作为能力包，统一管理系统提示词、工具、插件函数、技能、多模态 view_* 工具和压缩 Agent。
  • 📊 上下文指标：输入框下方动态展示轮次/步骤、工具次数、Token 用量和上下文窗口占用，上下文压缩在后台执行并以时间线通知结果。
  • 🧭 供应方管理：多供应方配置（OpenAI/Anthropic），支持 Base URL、请求头、代理。
  • 🎛️ 供应方选择：对话中可选供应方，并维护供应方级别模型列表与默认模型。
  • 🧩 供应方模板：支持 OpenAI Compatible 接入类型与厂商模板，预置端点和参数建议，便于接入第三方模型服务。
  • 🌍 广泛供应方覆盖：内置 OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、DashScope、Gemini、Ollama、Anthropic 等接入模板。
  • 🧰 函数调用：聚合插件与系统工具并增加唯一标识，避免名称冲突。
  • 🧩 结构化 MCP CLI 工具：单一 cli 工具聚合 MCP 服务配置、连接测试、资源读取和工具调用，并通过 doc 一次性返回全部 MCP 命令参数说明。
  • 🔌 MCP 客户端：基于官方 MCP Java SDK 管理并调用外部 MCP 服务，支持 stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP 传输，服务配置持久化并可连接测试。
  • 📦 插件管理：支持本地/URL/批量安装与卸载的工具调用。
  • 🧪 开发测试：开发面板可暴露当前插件实例的工具调用用于调试。
  • 📎 附件工作流：对话支持本地文件和图片附件，具备模型能力校验、剪贴板支持与上传优化。
  • 🖼️ 多模态输入：可按模型开启图片、音频、视频、文件附件能力，并对可读文件自动抽取文本上下文。
  • 🧠 Skills 管理：支持导入或编辑本地 SKILL.md 技能，按会话挂载，并将技能资源直接暴露给智能体运行时。
  • 📚 Skills 资源：references/examples/scripts 等资源文件可随技能挂载，并通过专用资源工具读取。
  • 🔗 Skill 运行时集成：Skills 与内置工具、插件工具共享同一个运行时 Toolkit，使 SkillBox 工具组与当前智能体会话保持一致。
  • 🎚️ 模型调优：提供独立模型调优面板，可配置流式输出、多模态能力以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 高级参数。
  • 🧾 参数建议：支持保存供应方默认参数与推荐参数，让模型配置在不同会话中更容易复用。
  • 💾 会话持久化：跨项目保留会话、启用的技能、草稿附件与当前上下文，适合长会话持续协作。
  • 🧠 运行时状态：会话运行时可保留记忆、工具状态与规划上下文，适合多步骤连续任务。
  • ⚙️ 智能体限制：可配置最大工具调用轮次并限制工具返回长度，避免超大上下文。
  • 📂 文件列表：jtools_list_files 支持 maxEntries 并返回截断信息。
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制和 Web 工具代理。
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：浏览器工具可创建临时 JCEF 浏览器会话，在用户选择后显示或隐藏运行，支持读取页面、观察元素 ref、点击、输入、等待、截图，并在完成后销毁动态工具窗口。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发
  • 通过厂商模板快速接入私有或第三方模型服务，而不必重建整套插件工作流

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🚀 Version v1.1.5.4

Latest Release / 最新版本

  • ♻️ Coding Session Rewrite: Rebuilt the chat dialog on the awake-claw coding-session path. Message events, processing tasks, append items, attachments, and context compaction replace the old message-card queue. This is a major version cut: no migration, no compatibility layer, no fallback. Delete ~/.jtools/agent/agent.db before upgrading.
  • 🧩 Coding Environment Capability Pack: Sessions bind a coding environment instead of treating Agent as the model source. System prompt, builtin tools, plugin functions, skills, multimodal view_* tools, and the compaction Agent all come from the environment. Creating a session requires an environment first.
  • 🎛️ Composer Alignment: Model, reasoning, attachments, and file context sit at the bottom-left of the input box; Sessions stays on the top bar and other management entries live in the top-right overflow menu. Advanced params flatten like the model manager, with additional JSON params shown directly. Context metrics appear under the composer.
  • 💬 Timeline Layout: The dialog is full width. Model replies stay left at 95% width; user bubbles stay right, grow with content, and wrap at 95%. Theme-aware Element Plus icons sit on a highlighted vertical track, with looser spacing and larger type.
  • 📝 Markdown and Code Blocks: Replies use CodeMirror/Lezer highlighting. HTML blocks can preview in an iframe. Download opens the IDE save dialog and sanitizes file names for Windows/macOS/Linux.
  • 🛠️ Runtime Tooling: Plugin functions register the same way as Agent management. web_fetch and bash output limits read global settings. MCP stays behind the cli tool. Distillation UI is removed; only compaction remains.
  • 🗜️ Async Context Compaction: Compact starts in the background and reports success or failure as timeline notices. Sending is blocked until a notice arrives; compact is blocked while a turn is processing or queued. Restarted in-flight compaction is marked failed so send does not stay locked.
  • ⚡ Streaming Performance: Deltas patch the current event instead of replacing the whole host state. The conversation auto-follows the bottom like awake-claw, and stops following when the user scrolls up.
  • 📎 Attachments: Text-only models receive file metadata (name, type, size, path) so they can call view_image. Timeline, processing, and queued cards preview images via data URLs. File context sends path and line range only, not selected text.
  • 🐛 Dialog Stability: Streaming replies and reasoning persist into events; refresh no longer drops history; compact/send/save run off the EDT; an empty database renders the dialog instead of crashing; global sessions use ~/.jtools/global.
  • 📚 Skill Create and Import: Skills can be created with a name and description, or imported from a directory that contains SKILL.md files. Nested skill folders are copied into ~/.jtools/skills.
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.4 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1154
  • ♻️ 编码会话重写：对话链路按 awake-claw 编码会话重建，消息事件、任务、追加、附件和上下文压缩替换旧消息卡队列。这是大版本切断：不迁移、不兼容、不降级。升级前请删除 ~/.jtools/agent/agent.db。
  • 🧩 编码环境能力包：会话绑定编码环境，不再把 Agent 当模型真源。系统提示词、内置工具、插件函数、技能、多模态 view_* 和压缩 Agent 都由环境提供。建会话必须先有环境。
  • 🎛️ 输入框与布局对齐：模型、推理、附件、文件上下文放在输入框左下角；会话入口留在顶栏，其余管理入口收进右上角二级菜单。高级参数与模型管理对齐，附加 JSON 参数直接铺开。上下文指标出现在输入框下方。
  • 💬 时间线布局：对话框全宽。模型回复靠左 95%；用户气泡靠右，随内容撑开，最大 95% 后软换行。图标改用 Element Plus 并适配亮暗主题，叠在高亮竖线上，行距和字号已拉开。
  • 📝 Markdown 与代码块：回复使用 CodeMirror/Lezer 高亮。HTML 代码块可 iframe 预览。下载走 IDE 保存对话框，并按 Windows/macOS/Linux 清洗文件名。
  • 🛠️ 运行时工具：插件函数按 Agent 管理页同一套方式注册。web_fetch 与 bash 输出上限读取全局设置。MCP 仍走 cli。蒸馏相关 UI 已移除，只保留压缩。
  • 🗜️ 异步上下文压缩：压缩在后台执行，成功或失败都以时间线通知呈现。未出通知前不能发送；模型处理中或排队中不能压缩。重启时未完成的压缩会标失败，避免发送一直锁死。
  • ⚡ 流式性能：增量只补当前事件，不再每次整包替换宿主状态。对话滚动按 awake-claw 贴底跟随，用户上翻后停止跟随。
  • 📎 附件：纯文本模型会收到文件名、类型、大小和路径等元数据，可通过 view_image 读取。时间线、处理中和排队卡片用 data URL 预览图片。文件上下文只发送路径和行号，不发送选中文本。
  • 🐛 对话框稳定性：流式回复和推理会写入事件；刷新不再丢历史；压缩/发送/保存离开 EDT；空库能打开对话框而不是崩溃；全局会话工作区为 ~/.jtools/global。
  • 📚 技能创建与导入：新增技能需要名称和描述。导入技能会从所选目录递归发现包含 SKILL.md 的技能，并复制到 ~/.jtools/skills。
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.4，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1154

🚀 Version v1.1.5.3

  • 🐛 User Shell Environment Fix: The bash tool previously ran commands through a login shell, which loads .zprofile/.bash_profile but never .zshrc/.bashrc; tools managed by sdkman, nvm, fnm or gvm were therefore missing, or resolved to a global build instead of the version selected by the manager
  • 🔄 Resolved Environment Caching: The full user environment is resolved once through an interactive login shell on first command execution and reused afterwards, so rc initialisation is not repeated per command; a failed resolution is not cached and is retried on the next call
  • 🧭 Per-Shell Probe Strategy: How the user environment is dumped is now declared by each shell: zsh/bash read their rc files, PowerShell loads $PROFILE for probing while command execution keeps -NoProfile, and cmd plus POSIX sh are not probed because they have no reliable user configuration mechanism
  • ♻️ Environment Refresh Parameter: The bash tool accepts a new refresh_env parameter to re-resolve the environment before execution when a command reports command not found, or after the user installs a tool or edits shell configuration, without restarting the IDE
  • 📝 Description Responsibility Split: The tool description now covers only tool identity, the shell in use and capability boundaries, while all parameter usage contracts live in their own parameter descriptions
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.3 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1153
  • 🐛 用户 Shell 环境丢失修复：bash 工具此前以 login shell 执行命令，只加载 .zprofile/.bash_profile 而不读 .zshrc/.bashrc，导致 sdkman、nvm、fnm、gvm 等版本管理器配置的工具找不到，或拿到全局版本而非版本管理器选定的版本
  • 🔄 用户环境解析与缓存：首次执行命令时用交互式登录 shell 解析一次完整用户环境并缓存复用，后续命令直接注入，不重复执行 rc 初始化；解析失败不写入缓存，下次调用自动重试
  • 🧭 按 Shell 声明探测策略：环境探测方式改由各 shell 自行声明：zsh/bash 读取 rc 文件，PowerShell 加载 $PROFILE（执行命令时仍保持 -NoProfile），cmd 与 POSIX sh 无可靠机制因而不探测
  • ♻️ 环境刷新参数：bash 工具新增 refresh_env 参数，命令报 command not found 或用户刚安装工具、刚修改 shell 配置时可强制重新解析环境后执行，无需重启 IDE
  • 📝 工具描述职责分离：工具描述只说明工具身份、所用 shell 和能力边界，参数使用约定全部下沉到各自的参数描述
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.3，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1153

🚀 Version v1.1.5.2

Previous Release / 上一版本

  • 📎 Append Attachments While Running: The append-message dialog now accepts selected or pasted images and files while a conversation is active; attachments can be sent alone or with text and follow the actual Provider message order into model context and restored history
  • 🖼️ Append Attachment Presentation: Appended-message cards show image thumbnails and file metadata, support image preview or opening files in the IDE, and provide attachment deduplication, removal and pre-send validation
  • 🛑 Layered Stop Semantics Restored: When tools are running, Stop cancels only the active tools and returns a “cancelled by user” result so the model can continue the turn; the whole model response is terminated only when no tool is active
  • 📐 Strict Chat Width Containment: Markdown, tables, code blocks, long links, tool details and appended messages stay inside the message area through wrapping or local scrolling instead of stretching the chat layout
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.2 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1152
  • 📎 运行中追加附件：进行中的对话支持在追加消息弹窗中选择或粘贴图片与文件；附件与文字可独立或组合发送，并按真实 Provider 消息顺序进入模型上下文和会话历史
  • 🖼️ 追加附件展示与打开：追加消息卡片展示图片缩略图和文件信息，支持点击预览图片或在 IDE 中打开文件；弹窗支持附件去重、移除和发送前检查
  • 🛑 停止层级语义恢复：有工具执行时停止按钮只取消当前工具，并将“用户手动取消”结果返回模型继续本轮对话；没有工具执行时才终止整个模型回复
  • 📐 对话内容宽度约束：Markdown、表格、代码块、长链接、工具详情及追加消息统一限制在消息区域内，超宽内容改为换行或局部滚动，避免撑开对话布局
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本号升级到 v1.1.5.2，并同步 SDK Helper 版本元数据到 1152

🚀 Version v1.1.5.1

Earlier Release / 更早版本

  • 💬 Append Messages While Running: Active chat queue items now accept additional user messages without stopping the current model request or creating another queued turn; each append is delivered as an independent user message
  • 🔁 Correct Loop Continuation: A provider loop now continues when either tool calls or pending append messages exist, so a tool-free model response no longer terminates before queued appends are delivered
  • 🧾 Exact Append History: Model logs persist append metadata together with the actual provider message order, preserving the sequence of tool calls, tool results and appended user messages when history is restored
  • 🛑 Cancellation Boundary: Stopping a turn cancels model and tool requests, atomically closes the append channel and removes undelivered append messages
  • 🎨 Collapsible Append Display: User cards provide group-level and per-message expansion, internal scrolling for large lists and long content, and correctly formatted timestamps without leaking fractional-second digits
  • 📦 Version Metadata Sync: Bumped the plugin release to v1.1.5.1 and aligned SDK helper version metadata to 1151
  • 💬 运行中追加消息：进行中的对话队列项支持继续追加用户消息；追加内容按独立用户消息投递，无需停止当前模型请求或重新排队
  • 🔁 工具循环继续条件修复：下一轮由“存在工具调用或待处理追加消息”共同决定；即使模型未调用工具，只要有追加消息也会继续请求模型

  • 📚 read_project_files 支持 VFS URL：可直接读取 find_project_files / find_project_classes 在 include_global=true 时返回的 jar://、jrt://、file:// 路径，用于查看依赖或 SDK 源码

  • 📝 IDE 工具描述重写：按真实能力重写 9 个 IDE 项目工具的描述，补齐批量、未保存内容、索引来源、边界约束等信息

  • ⚡ 停止对话卡顿修复：停止动作整体放到后台线程，避免在 EDT 上触发 OkHttp 关闭与日志写回导致界面卡顿
  • ✂️ 工具输出截断保留：工具输出超过 8KB 时不再整段丢弃，改为保留前 8KB 并在末尾附截断说明与下一步提示，按 UTF-8 字符边界安全截断
  • 🔄 bash 新增 refresh_vfs 参数：bash 执行后可选刷新 VFS（默认关闭），改动磁盘文件且随后要用 read_project_files 读取时传 true，避免读到 IDE 缓存旧内容

  • 📐 统一为行区间：文件上下文选区改为上报 startLine/endLine，read_project_files 移除 offset_ranges 只保留 line_ranges，消除 offset 与行号两套口径及其互斥报错
